description: Local business leads: up to 10 Google Maps businesses for a search and place, each with address, phone, website, rating, reviews, plus emails (checked), phones and social profiles found on its website. Price: $0.10 USDC per call on Base, paid with x402; not charged if the call fails.

contacts.description: Visit each website for emails, phones and social links (default true)

language.description: Language for Maps fields, e.g. en (default)

limit.description: Businesses to return, up to the tier cap (10 or 20)

location.description: Where, e.g. Kathmandu, Nepal or Austin, TX (optional if the query names the place)

query.description: What to search for on Google Maps, e.g. dentists, coworking space, hotels

name: leads
